author: iDiamondPorkchop
body:
Dear Staff,
   Avicus was my first server. Even though I'm banned, it's still the first server on my multiplayer list. That's how much Avicus means to me. When I first started playing Avicus, when it was still MCZone, it was a really great place. It had an atmosphere of no negativity at all. Then when I got banned, every cursed, team-griefed, and did bad things. So my dream is to come back to Avicore and change things, to get the positive atmosphere again. Avicus means so much to me. I've been staying on the forums ever since I've been banned, because I love Avicus and all my friends are there. It would be great if I could come back to Avicus with a fresh start, meet all my friends again, and keep a positive attitude. I would greatly try to get the positive atmosphere again. It is my favorite server, I am devoted, and I only ask one thing: To come back.

                                                                                                                                                    ~Diamondporkchop3
